name: warnlist
author: kirin
description: Replaces Red's [p]warnings with a paginated embed that shows when each warning was given, and sends a custom DM on [p]warn.
install_msg: Thanks for installing the warnlist cog! Load it after the Warnings cog.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store data about users; it only displays warnings stored by Red's core Warnings cog.
